brief: A one-page website for Brew Lab, a small specialty coffee shop in Indiranagar, Bengaluru. Visitors see the menu with prices, the opening hours and where to find the shop, and they can pre-order a coffee for pickup. Users: coffee lovers and office staff nearby. Problem: people cannot see the menu or order ahead. Must-have: menu with prices, pre-order form, map or address, opening hours. Constraints: one page only, works on phones, no payment. Success: 30 pre-orders per week.
outcome: Done: the site is workable. Every done-when item passes with Audit's evidence and the render check is clean.

asked: Please send these: What items do you sell, and what is the price of each one (in rupees); Which days and what times is the shop open; What is the full street address of the shop in Indiranagar? Do you also want a phone number or email shown; When someone pre-orders, how should their order reach you.
questions_to_user.answer: @Requester To build the page I need a few real details from you. Please send them as exact as you want them shown. Please send these: What items do you sell, and what is the price of each one (in rupees); Which days and what times is the shop open; What is the full street address of the shop in Indiranagar? Do you also want a phone number or email shown; When someone pre-orders, how should their order reach you.

asked: Please send these: What drinks and food do you sell, and what is the price of each in rupees? For example: Cappuccino, 180; Which days is the shop open, and from what time to what time each day; What is the full street address of the shop in Indiranagar? Do you also want a phone number or email shown on the page? If yes, please type it; When someone pre-orders, how should their order reach you.
questions_to_user.answer:
Items and prices (rupees): Filter coffee 90, Cappuccino 160, Latte 180, Cold brew 200, Masala chai 80, Almond croissant 140, Banana bread slice 120.
Open: Monday to Saturday 7:30 am to 9:00 pm, Sunday 8:30 am to 6:00 pm.
Address: 12, 100 Feet Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru 560038.
Contact: show phone +91 98450 12345 and email hello@brewlab.example.
Pre-orders: the customer enters name, phone, items and pickup time, and the order is emailed to hello@brewlab.example. No online payment, they pay at pickup.
